psnprofiles.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

sixshore.name: sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List (summarizing PowerPyx and Push Square)

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 are done — there is nothing extra to do for it. Treat it as the finish line, not a task: work the checklist in order and it arrives on its own. PowerPyx puts the whole run at about 200 hours and Push Square at 250 or more, so plan for the long haul.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing — it is the first thing the game asks of you and it cannot be missed. Exophase shows every tracked player has it, so if you have started the game you almost certainly already own it.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. The chapter trophies pop a little late — PowerPyx notes the first three pop once you clear the first mission or two of the next chapter, so do not worry if it does not appear the instant the chapter ends.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Same timing note as the other chapter trophies: it can pop a mission or two into Chapter 3, so keep playing and it will come.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Keep playing the story; it pops as you cross into the next chapter's opening missions.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. The last chapter trophy before the finale — cross into the final stretch and it pops.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. This is the story's end — finish it and the gold is yours. One playthrough is enough, and free roam continues after the story, so nothing is lost by finishing.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. It is one of the six named-mission trophies; it pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist. A named story mission — finish it and the trophy follows.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play. A named story mission — finish it and the trophy follows.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners. A named story mission — finish it and the trophy follows.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown. A named story mission at the airport — finish it and the trophy follows.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory. A named story mission — finish it and the trophy follows.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion. The checklist opens after the story, under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, and progress made during the story already counts. PowerPyx calls it lenient — closer to 60% true completion — but it is still the longest grind: 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 meditations, 300 stunts, and everything in robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. This is the trophy the 200-hour estimate is really about.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Any kind counts — stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps. PowerPyx counts 397 stunts in the world, and 100% completion needs 300, so keep jumping after this pops. The counter in this guide tracks your progress toward 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. PowerPyx lists nine: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. One try each is enough — you do not need to win or finish them all.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. There are 42 of them. Gold every one — silver or bronze medals do not count — and this pops. Work them in any order; the ranges are open from early on.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. There are 14 locations. Win one race at each — you do not need to win them all, just one per location.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct races count — road, drone and other race types all feed the same total. The counter here tracks how many different races you have won.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal texts you a fishing spot after you meet him in Chapter 1 — go when he invites you. Exophase shows this is one of the most-earned early trophies, so it comes naturally if you follow his invitations.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Play any in-game video game through to the end — three run on the TV at home and a fourth on arcade machines. Pick whichever you like; finishing one is enough.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand is Lucia-only and starts with a phone call in Chapter 3. Follow the strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's strand is treasure diving — 7 shipwrecks in total. He goes quiet after Chapter 1 and returns later, so do not worry if he disappears; it is not missable.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's strand runs at the mud club in Kelly County and opens in Chapter 2.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Only some side questlines count, and PowerPyx is still confirming exactly which — do the stranger strands as they appear and this fills in. The strands can be finished after the story, and this trophy is not part of 100% completion.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's strand is a wish list of 16 sports cars and opens in Chapter 3. Deliver the cars he asks for until the strand ends.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand is shutting down labs in Vice City; it is Jason-only and starts in Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableWhy: PowerPyx flags it as the only possibly-missable trophy: one Chapter 1 meditation (Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house) is gone after Chapter 1, and it is unclear whether it counts toward the 18 spots. Push Square lists no known missables.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. There are 18 meditation spots. THE ONE TO PROTECT: during Chapter 1, one morning at Jason's house, Lucia says she is going to meditate and walks out to the balcony — follow her and accept the optional quest. That meditation is gone after Chapter 1, and PowerPyx flags this as the only trophy that may be missable (Push Square lists none known). It is unclear whether that one counts toward the 18 — PowerPyx had done it when the trophy unlocked — so do it when it comes up; it takes a minute and removes the risk.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. This is Jason-only, from Chapter 2. PowerPyx has not confirmed which animal triggers it — clearing all 15 of Bret's target decks, which 100% completion needs, should cover it. Work Bret's quests and hunt what he points at.

trophies.name: Don’t Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 sets in the world; any 3 complete sets pop this. Cards are found across Leonida — pick up every card you see and the sets fill in.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Open the WAiNK phone app and scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures — all of them count. Scan everything you pass; 100 comes quickly if you make a habit of it.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. The game has 80 challenges in eight groups of ten. Any 50 count — 100% completion needs 70, so this arrives on the way to the platinum.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. It becomes possible once both characters can roam together in Chapter 2. Bank jobs give 4 stars anyway, so it often pops during a heist — get to 4 stars with your partner along, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the heat dies.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row with your partner along and keep the wanted level the whole time. PowerPyx says it pops about 30 seconds after the third shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning them with the WAiNK app is enough — you do not have to drive them. Scan every new vehicle you see; 100% completion needs 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning after this pops.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus with enemies grouped together and drop five before it ends. PowerPyx says gang members count, while soldiers, police and civilians seem not to — pick a gang fight for it.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal a passenger jet docked at a gate at Vice City International Airport and fly about 1 km away. Get on board, get it moving, and get clear of the airport.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Steal a military tank. PowerPyx found them at Mile Zero Air Station in the southwest — go in ready for a fight, grab a Rhino and get it out.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. You need the Snap Gun, which a Chapter 3 main mission gives you. With it, get in and out of a jewelry store unseen — no alarms, no witnesses.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank jobs open through an optional mission in Chapter 4. There are 8 vaults in total and 100% completion needs all of them, so this is the start of a longer job — rob five and get away clean.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. The first bank job counts, or you can blow open a truck's back door with a sticky bomb earlier. Either way, take the cash and escape.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Clear the fog from the entire map. A plane is fastest — fly a grid over the state until no fog is left.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. There are 9 gangs — hit one operation per gang. 100% completion needs all 39 operations, so this is the first lap of a longer robbery tour.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact method is not yet confirmed by any guide — go to Ocean Beach, find a bar with a view, and order a cocktail. This guide will say so when a guide writer confirms the spot; do not trust any walkthrough that claims a precise location without a source.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The exact method is not yet confirmed. The description points to a showroom escape — try the showrooms you find and look for a way to smash out. No guide has verified the spot yet, so treat any precise claim as unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Take all 3 key valuables from the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn. The robbery comes back later, so it is not missable — if you miss a valuable, return and try again.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Max out strength on both Jason and Lucia. Work out together and both make progress — gyms and training raise strength, so train both characters until each is maxed.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). Do 500 things that change your criminal profile. It comes naturally over a full playthrough — every choice that moves your profile counts toward the 500.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Not yet confirmed by any guide — PowerPyx suspects a link to a Payday Loans store. Until a guide writer confirms it, treat any claimed method as unconfirmed and keep an eye on Payday Loans locations.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Not yet confirmed — PowerPyx suspects a UFO questline. If you see something strange in the sky or out in the wilds, follow it; this trophy is tied to something unusual, and no guide has pinned it down yet.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Not yet confirmed — the in-game hint points to a melee attack from a moving vehicle, and PowerPyx suspects a kick from a motorcycle. Try a melee strike from a moving bike and see if it pops.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies and add up across them. The dye pack jammer unlocks in a Chapter 3 main mission — after that, launder through your fences until the total hits $250,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos get you there fastest. It counts everything you buy, so normal spending adds up — big purchases close the gap quickly.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. There are 8 purchasable garages; PowerPyx puts the total at $160,000. The real estate app arrives in Chapter 2 — buy garages as you can afford them.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. You need garage space first, so pair it with Little Boxes — store ten vehicles in your garages and register each one in the app.
